brand_contract: Buono: Modern Italian. Neighbourhood soul. 6 / 6 / 6: PASTAS · FOCACCIAS · SALADS.

evidence_states.MEASURED: Directly observed or verified in this project.
evidence_states.PUBLISHED_UNVERIFIED: Published by a primary vendor or venue but not confirmed by invoice, quote, purchase or physical pack.
evidence_states.INFERRED: Explicit modelling input derived from available evidence and requiring validation.
evidence_states.UNKNOWN: Not established and not represented as known.

summary.required_contract: Exactly 6 pastas, 6 focaccias and 6 salads, each with 4 staples and 2 rotations.
summary.weighting_assumption: Alpha unit mix only: focaccia 40%, pasta 35%, salad 25%; staples generally weighted above rotations. This is not observed demand and must be replaced with actual POS mix.
summary.arithmetic: Per line: effective purchase quantity = recipe quantity / (1 - waste_percent/100); line cost = effective quantity x unit cost; ingredient portion cost = batch cost / yield; total cost = ingredient portion cost + takeaway packaging; net sale = GST-inclusive price / 1.10; COGS percent = total cost / net sale x 100.
unresolved_unknowns: No delivered Sydney wholesale quote or invoice has been obtained for any ingredient or packaging line.
Fresh produce uses current Sydney organic retail pricing as a conservative proxy, not restaurant wholesale pricing.
Basil, sage, orange, pepitas, mayonnaise, breadcrumbs and radicchio use explicit inferred model inputs.
Filtered water is operationally quantified but held at zero marginal recipe cost because a utility rate has not been allocated.
Supplier freight, account discounts, minimum order quantities and substitutions are excluded.
Cooked yields, brine drained weights, bunch weights, actual trim loss and portion weights have not been kitchen measured.
Allergen declarations and cross-contact controls require supplier specifications and chef verification.
Labour, energy, merchant fees, delivery commissions and venue overhead are not included in recipe COGS.
Observed product-level sales mix and willingness to pay do not yet exist.

gst_treatment.caveat: Confirm product tax codes and mixed-supply treatment with the accountant and supplier invoices before launch.

reasons: COGS 78.95% exceeds 33% baseline; do not suppress the ingredient or portion cost. Test supplier invoice pricing, waste and willingness to pay.
